wiz.notFound: Course not found — it may have been deleted
wiz.preview.title: Student preview
wiz.preview.noContent: Sections and lessons you add in Content appear here.
wiz.banner.inReviewBody: Our team usually reviews within 2–3 working days. We'll notify you by email.
wiz.banner.changesBody: Fix it, then resubmit from Review & publish.
wiz.banner.liveEdits: Content edits go live right away. Title, price or target changes are reviewed first.
wiz.banner.revisionPending: Your title/price/target changes are waiting for review — students see the current version until approved.
wiz.new.title: Start with a course title
wiz.new.body: Everything else comes next — each change saves automatically.
wiz.new.tip1: Subject + exam + code: "Data Structures — Midterm Crash Course (CSE-2203)"
wiz.new.tip2: Students search by course code, so include it.
wiz.basics.introBody: This is what students see first in search and on the course page.
wiz.basics.title: Course title
wiz.basics.titleHint: Include the subject, exam and course code
wiz.basics.titleErr: At least 5 characters, or it won't be saved
wiz.basics.shortHint: Shown under the course card · at least 30 characters
wiz.basics.shortPh: Linked lists, stacks, queues and trees in 6 hours before the midterm — with 5 years of past questions solved.
wiz.basics.descPh: What's inside, how it's organised, which textbook chapters it covers…
wiz.basics.learningsPh: Code linked-list insertion and deletion yourself
wiz.basics.notFor: Who this course is not for
wiz.basics.notForBody: Be honest — the wrong buyers mean more refunds
wiz.basics.notForPh: Complete beginners who haven't programmed yet
wiz.basics.coverBody: Without an image, the title shows on a colour
wiz.basics.faqEmpty: No questions yet. Two or three help sales.
wiz.basics.faqQPh: Will this work for Section B too?
wiz.basics.faqAPh: Yes, both sections share the syllabus — only the lab part differs.
wiz.target.intro: Tell us which university, department and semester this course is for. Matching students see a "your university's syllabus" badge. Add a target per university.
wiz.target.generalHint: Visible to students from any university — add a subject or code so they can find it.
wiz.target.needInstitution: Pick a university or turn on General
wiz.target.codeHint: Filled in when you pick a subject
wiz.target.subject: Subject
wiz.target.needSubject: Add a subject or a course code
wiz.target.proposeBody: Once an admin approves it, it joins the list for everyone. Your course keeps it meanwhile.
wiz.content.syllabus: Match the syllabus for {subjects} — one lesson per chapter builds trust.
wiz.content.syllabusNone: Add a subject in Target to see syllabus hints here.
wiz.content.emptyBody: Section → Chapter → Lesson, e.g. "Midterm Part 1" → "Linked List" → "Insertion at Head".
wiz.content.confirmBody: "{title}" and everything inside it will be removed from the course.
wiz.lesson.title: Lesson title
wiz.lesson.quizSoon: MCQ mock tests aren't lessons — create them from "Mock tests & flashcards" at the bottom of the Content step.
wiz.lesson.videoHint: MP4/MOV/WebM · click or drop here · large files resume where they stopped
wiz.lesson.linkErr: Enter a link starting with https://
wiz.lesson.durErr: Write the duration as 12:30 or minutes (45)
wiz.lesson.uploadKeepOpen: Keep this tab open while uploading — you can keep editing other lessons.
wiz.lesson.pdfHint: Up to 100 MB · students see it watermarked
wiz.lesson.bodyPh: In this lesson we'll see why we use a linked list instead of an array…
wiz.res.title: Course resources
wiz.res.body: Notes, previous years' questions and slides — available to enrolled students.
wiz.res.uploadHint: PDF, PPTX or image · up to 100 MB
wiz.price.title: Price
wiz.price.body: Most midterm crash courses sell between ৳199 and ৳499.
wiz.price.freeHint: Helps new teachers earn reviews and followers
wiz.price.compareHint: Shown struck through; must be higher than the price
wiz.price.accessBody: How long students keep access after buying
wiz.price.couponsSoon: Set up discount coupons and multi-course bundle offers from the Coupons page.
wiz.price.publishedNote: This course is live — price changes are reviewed first; the current price shows until then.
wiz.price.err.required: Enter a price or make it free
wiz.price.err.min: Price must be at least ৳50 to submit
wiz.price.err.compare: Compare-at price must be higher than the price
wiz.review.title: Pre-publish checklist
wiz.review.body: When everything is green, you can submit for review.
wiz.review.declaration: I confirm this content is my own (or I have permission to use it), and the course makes no guarantee claims like "100% common" or "will definitely come in the exam".
wiz.review.notVerified: You can submit once you're verified. Your draft stays saved.
wiz.review.after: You can keep editing after submitting; reviewers see the latest version.
mock.title: Mock tests & flashcards
mock.subtitle: MCQ mock tests and flashcards appear in the student's Exam Mode and feed their readiness score. Changes go live immediately, without course review.
mock.emptyBody: Add a timed test of 20–30 questions so students can check themselves before the exam.
mock.deleteBodyAttempts: "{title}" will be deleted permanently. Students attempted it {n} times — their results will disappear too.
mock.attemptsWarn: Students attempted this test {n} times. Saving rewrites the questions — old scores stay, but changed questions won't show in old reviews.
mock.f.title: Test name
mock.f.question: Question
mock.f.questionPh: e.g. What is the time complexity of inserting at the head of a singly linked list?
mock.f.explanationHint: Shown after the test: why this answer is right
mock.correctHint: Exactly one correct answer. Empty options are dropped.
mock.errCount: {n} questions need fixing — see the red highlights
mock.leaveBody: Your changes to this test will be lost.
mock.err.title: Use at least 3 characters
mock.err.emptyCorrect: The option marked correct is empty
cards.title: Flashcards
cards.body: A question or term on the front, a short answer on the back. Students revise by marking known / not yet.
cards.emptyBody: Definitions, formulas, time complexities — flashcards are best for quick revision.
cards.err: Fill both sides or remove the card
wiz.exam.title: Mock tests & flashcards
wiz.exam.body: Timed MCQ tests and revision cards go to the student's Exam Mode. Saves go live immediately.
